| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Threshold** `threshold` | 3 | 0.5 to 10 | How far a peak must rise above the median of its ring, in natural log units. 3 means about 20 times stronger. |
| **Lowest frequency** `minFrequency` | 0.05 | 0.01 to 0.4 cycles/px | Peaks closer than this to the center of the spectrum are left alone, since the center holds the main content of the image. |
| **Most peaks** `maxPeaks` | 8 | 1 to 32 | The most peaks to remove, the strongest first. |
| **Notch radius** `radius` | 0.01 | 0.002 to 0.1 cycles/px | The radius D_0 of the Gaussian notch at each peak, in cycles per pixel. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
